items.label: Comfortable & Stretchy Fabric
items.value: Made from a blend of Rayon and Spandex, this off the shoulder top for women is soft, comfortable, lightweight, and breathable with just the right amount of stretch for all-day comfort.

items.label: Elaborate Design
items.value: The elegant off-shoulder cut highlights the collarbone and shoulder line, while the waist-hugging gathered design naturally defines the silhouette. Short sleeves keep it fresh and versatile—feminine yet casual.

items.label: Suitable for Multiple Occasions
items.value: Whether for daily casual wear, office work, dating, or light social events, these short sleeve tops for women fit right in. Simple design with a modern touch—appropriate without being overdone.

items.label: Perfect for Spring, Summer & Early Fall
items.value: Lightweight, breathable, and slightly stretchy, the off-shoulder design adds extra coolness. Ideal for spring, summer, and early fall—a practical choice for warmer seasons.

items.label: Care
items.value: Machine washable (recommended in a laundry bag). Wash on a gentle cycle with cold water. Do not tumble dry on high heat.
